title: Perturbative Defect CFT Data in Scalar Models and Consistency Conditions
summary: We compute defect CFT data through $O(ε)$ for scalar line defects in the $O(N)$, hypercubic, hypertetrahedral, $O(m)\times O(n)$ biconical, and $MN$ models in $d=4-ε$. The $O(N)$ theory provides a benchmark; the datasets for the other four models are new. For the branches considered, we determine spectra, operator mixing, two- and three-point coefficients in a specified perturbative basis, and four-point functions with identical or paired external operators of integer dimension $n\leq2$ at $ε=0$.
